import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { dummyEvents } from '../data/dummyEvents'; import { FaCalendarAlt, FaUsers, FaChartLine, FaTrophy, FaEdit, FaTrash, FaPlus, FaSearch, FaFilter } from 'react-icons/fa'; const AdminDashboard = () => { const [events, setEvents] = useState([]); const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(''); const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState('All'); const [animateStats, setAnimateStats] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setEvents(dummyEvents); setTimeout(() => setAnimateStats(true), 500); }, []); const totalEvents = events.length; const totalRegistrations = events.reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.registrations, 0); const upcomingEvents = events.filter((event) => new Date(event.date) >= new Date()).length; const categories = [...new Set(events.map(event => event.category))]; const filteredEvents = events.filter(event => { const matchesSearch = event.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()); const matchesCategory = filterCategory === 'All' || event.category === filterCategory; return matchesSearch && matchesCategory; }); const recentEvents = [...events].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date)).slice(0, 5); return (
